shape.repeats_basis: all 22573 ids with more than one row sit in more than one portfolio group, and every one of them is identical across its rows on the eight allowed descriptive columns (dates, action, type, sub-type, flow label), so the rows differ only in the portfolio group on what was read. NOT_ESTABLISHED by this read: whether the copies are also identical on the money columns and the account columns, which the order forbids reading; and 590 of the repeated ids also hold two or more rows inside ONE portfolio group, which is a repeat the group does not explain (not examined further: the cell asks whether a transaction repeats per group).
shape.how_firm_was_told: No firm column and no firm prefix exists in this store (the object carries no firm field; the key has no firm segment). The firm is told by the BUCKET: the naming registry binds bucket opal-data-bd to scope 49financial (infra/logic/registry/key_rulings.json lines 25 and 48 'bucket-alias opal-data-bd, scope 49financial'; lib/tests/test_opal_naming_keyfill.py line 144 and test_opal_naming_rootcheck.py line 330 treat opal-data-bd as 49financial's bucket and refuse a cottonwood path in it), and the ADVI_STITCH decomposition (the ADVI_STITCH run's DECOMP.md under workflows/atom_decomposition/runs/advi-stitch/ (the August run) line 93, STI-b-0 and STI-b-2) names silver/ in this bucket as the source of the 49financial silver_legacy copy. The other firms' stores are other buckets (opal-data-cot, opal-data-inf). One prefix of one bucket was read; no other firm's prefix or bucket was read. The sampled day objects do NOT match the copy's byte-for-byte (see row IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W116-S2), so the bucket binding, not an object match, is what tells the firm.

read_method.instrument: boto3 (region us-east-1) ranged GETs through a seekable wrapper and pyarrow read of ONLY ten columns: transaction_id, portfolio_group, trade_date, return_date, entry_date, settle_date, action, transaction_type, transaction_sub_type, external_flow. The parquet footer was read first (column names and types only). No money column, no account column, no client column was requested; no object was downloaded to disk; counts only were printed.

impact: No reader found in the searched trees both sums an amount without the id and serves something. The one unkeyed sum with a name (data/analysis nna_suppression_schwab_validation.py) writes only stdout and a local file; E_02 sums units unkeyed but is a printed diagnostic. Every served amount reader found in the Black Diamond gold pipeline (A_03, B_01, B_03, nna_flows and so through C_01) dedupes on the transaction id before it sums.
